data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Rhodos', meaning 'rosy' or 'roses'. In Greek mythology, Rhodos was an island where the sun god Helios kept his chariot horses. The island was also a symbol of the goddess Aphrodite and was famed for its beautiful roses. As a name, Rossie carries the symbolism of beauty, love, and the sun. The name Rossie carries the meaning “Little Roses” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rossie usually hope their child will grow to embody little roses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
